name: gone-in-space-desktop
description: Desktop (Electron) Steam wrapper around the Gone in Space PWA — bundles the game on-device and serves it from a private scheme, plus Steam Cloud saves and achievements.

scripts.dist: npm run bundle && npm run build && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run bundle && npm run build && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run bundle && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --publish never
